# Sushanta Digital

> Digital marketing and website studio run by Sushanta Lohar in Manbazar, Purulia, West Bengal, India (susanta.me). We build fast websites, WhatsApp lead-capture automation, Facebook & Instagram ads, local promotion campaigns and AI-made videos for local businesses across West Bengal and India. Not a CSC or government service centre, and not "Susanta Digital Seva Kendra".

Contact: +91 95477 71118 (WhatsApp) · contact@susanta.me · Languages: English, Bengali, Hindi
Website plans (one-time): Starter ₹6,999 · Growth & Automation ₹14,999 · Full Digital Suite ₹24,999. AI videos from ₹800 (under 1 minute), ₹1,599 (1 minute), ₹10,000 (5 minutes).

## Services
- [Lead Generation](https://susanta.me/services/lead-generation): landing page, local ads and WhatsApp follow-up, every lead saved to Google Sheets
- [WhatsApp Automation](https://susanta.me/services/whatsapp): 24/7 auto-replies, menus, bookings and follow-ups
- [Local Business Promotion](https://susanta.me/services/local-business-promotion): offers, posters, social media and local influencer campaigns
- [AI Video Production](https://susanta.me/services/ai-video): AI-made Reels, ads and explainers with script, voiceover, captions and music; from ₹800
- [Websites & Apps](https://susanta.me/services/web-dev): fast mobile-first websites that lead to WhatsApp or a call
- [Meta Ads](https://susanta.me/services/meta-ads): Facebook and Instagram ads targeted 5–15 km around a business
